verses.en: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
verses.am: አዳም፥

verses.en: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
verses.am: ሴት፥ ሄኖስ፥ ቃይናን፥ መላልኤል፥

verses.en: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.am: ያሬድ፥ ሄኖክ፥ ማቱሳላ፥ ላሜሕ፥

verses.en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.am: ኖኅ፥ ሴም፥ ካም፥ ያፌት።

verses.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.am: የያፌት ልጆች፤ ጋሜር፥ ማጎግ፥ ማዴ፥

verses.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.am: ያዋን፥ ቶቤል፥ ሞሳሕ፥ ቴራስ።

verses.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.am: የጋሜርም ልጆች፤ አስከናዝ፥ ሪፋት፥ ቴርጋማ። የያዋንም ልጆች፤ ኤሊሳ፥ ተርሴስ፥ ኪቲም፥ ሮድኢ።

verses.en: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.am: የካምም ልጆች፤ ኩሽ፥ ምጽራይም፥ ፉጥ፥ ከነዓን።

verses.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.am: የኩሽም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ኤውላጥ፥ ሰብታ፥ ራዕማ፥ ሰብቃታ። የራዕማም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ድዳን።

verses.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.am: ኩሽም ናምሩድን ወለደ፤ እርሱም በምድር ኃያል መሆንን ጀመረ።

verses.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.am: ምጽራይምም ሉዲምን፥ ዐናሚምን፥ ላህቢምን፥

verses.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
verses.am: ነፍተሂምን፥ ፈትሩሲምን፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን የወጡበትን ከስሉሂምን፥ ከፍቶሪምን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.am: ከነዓንም የበኵር ልጁን ሲዶንን፥

verses.en: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.am: ኬጢን፥ ኢያቡሳዊውን፥ አሞራዊውን፥

verses.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.am: ጌርጌሳዊውን፥ ኤዊያዊውን፥ ዐርካዊውን፥

verses.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.am: ሲኒያዊውን፥ አራዴዎንን፥ ሰማሪዎንን፥ አማቲን ወለደ።

verses.en: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.am: የሴምም ልጆች፤ ኤላም፥ አሦር፥ አርፋክስድ፥ ሉድ፥ አራም፥ ዑፅ፥ ሁል፥ ጌቴር፥ ሞሳሕ።

verses.en: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.am: አርፋክስድም ቃይንምን ወለደ፤ ቃይንምም ሳላን ወለደ፤ ሳላም ዔቦርን ወለደ።

verses.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.am: ለዔቦርም ሁለት ልጆች ተወለዱለት፤ በዘመኑ ምድር ተከፍላለችና የአንደኛው ስም ፋሌቅ ተባለ፤ የወንድሙም ስም ዮቅጣን ነበረ።

verses.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.am: ዮቅጣንም አልሞዳድን፥

verses.en: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.am: ሣሌፍን፥ ሐስረሞትን፥ ያራሕን፥ ሀዶራምን፥

verses.en: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.am: አውዛልን፥ ደቅላን፥ ዖባልን፥ አቢማኤልን፥

verses.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.am: ሳባን፥ ኦፊርን፥ ኤውላጥን፥ ዮባብን ወለደ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የዮቅጣን ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ልጆች፤ ይስሐቅ፥ እስማኤል።

verses.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ልጆች፤ ይስሐቅ፥ እስማኤል።

verses.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ልጆች፤ ይስሐቅ፥ እስማኤል።

verses.en: Abram; the same is Abraham.
verses.am: ትውልዳቸውም እንደዚህ ነው። የእስማኤል በኵር ልጅ ነባዮት፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ቄዳር፥ ነብዳኤል፥ መብሳም፥

verses.en: The sons of Abraham; Yitschaq, and Ishmael.
verses.am: ማስማዕ፥ ዱማ፥ ማሣ፥ ኩዳን፥ ቴማን፥

verses.en: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.am: ኢጡር፥ ናፌስ፥ ቄድማ፤ እነዚህ የእስማኤል ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.am: የአብርሃምም ገረድ የኬጡራ ልጆች፤ ዘምራን፥ ዮቅሳን፥ ሜዳን፥ ምድያም፥ የስቦቅ፥ ስዌሕ። የዮቅሳንም ልጆች፤ ሳባ፥ ድዳን።

verses.en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.am: የምድያምም ልጆች፤ ጌፌር፥ ዔፌር፥ ሄኖኅ፥ አቢዳዕ፥ ኤልዳዓ። እነዚህ ሁሉ የኬጡራ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.am: አብርሃምም ይስሐቅን ወለደ። የይስሐቅም ልጆች ዔሳውና እስራኤል ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.am: የዔሳው ልጆች፤ ኤልፋዝ፥ ራጉኤል፥ የዑስ፥ የዕላም፥ ቆሬ።

verses.en: And Abraham begat Yitschaq. The sons of Yitschaq; Esau and Yisra'el.
verses.am: የኤልፋዝ ልጆች፤ ቴማን፥ ኦማር፥ ስፎ፥ ጎቶም፥ ቄኔዝ፥ ቲምናዕ፥ አማሌቅ።

verses.en: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.am: የራጉኤል ልጆች፤ ናሖት፥ ዛራ፥ ሣማ፥ ሚዛህ።

verses.en: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.am: የሴይርም ልጆች፤ ሎጣን፥ ሦባል፥ ጽብዖን፥ ዓና፥ ዲሶን፥ ኤጽር፥ ዲሳን።

verses.en: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.am: የሎጣንም ልጆች፤ ሖሪ፥ ሔማም፤ ቲሞናዕ የሎጣን እኅት ነበረች።

verses.en: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.am: የሦባል ልጆች፤ ዓልዋን፥ ማኔሐት፥ ዔባል፥ ስፎ፥ አውናም። የጽብዖንም ልጆች፤ አያ፥ ዓና።

verses.en: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
verses.am: የዓና ልጅ፤ ዲሶን። የዲሶንም ልጆች፤ ሔምዳን፥ ኤስባን፥ ይትራን፥ ክራን።

verses.en: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.am: የኤጽር ልጆች፤ ቢልሐን፥ ዛዕዋን፥ ዓቃን። የዲሳን ልጆች፤ ዑፅ፥ አራን።

verses.en: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ልጆች ላይ ገና ንጉሥ ሳይነግሥ በኤዶምያስ ምድር የነገሡ ነገሥታት እነዚህ ናቸው። የቢዖር ልጅ ባላቅ፤ የከተማይቱም ስም ዲንሃባ ነበረ።

verses.en: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.am: ባላቅም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የባሶራ ሰው የዛራ ልጅ ኢዮባብ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Yisra'el; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.am: ኢዮባብም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የቴማን አገር ሰው ሑሳም ነገሠ።

verses.en: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.am: ሑሳምም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ምድያምን የመታው የባዳድ ልጅ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማይቱም ስም ዓዊት ነበረ።

verses.en: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.am: ሃዳድም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የመሥሬቃ ሰው ሠምላ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.am: ሠምላም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ በወንዙ አጠገብ ያለችው የረሆቦት ሰው ሳኡል ነገሠ።

verses.en: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.am: ሳኡልም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ የዓክቦር ልጅ በኣልሐናን ነገሠ።

verses.en: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.am: በኣልሐናንም ሞተ፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ ሃዳድ ነገሠ፤ የከተማይቱም ስም ፋዑ ነበረ፤ ሚስቱም የሜዛሃብ ልጅ የመጥሬድ ልጅ መሄጣብኤል ነበረች፤ ሃዳድም ሞተ።

verses.en: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.am: የኤዶምያስም አለቆች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ቲምናዕ አለቃ፥ ዓልዋ አለቃ፥ የቴት አለቃ፥

verses.en: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.am: አህሊባማ አለቃ፥ ኤላ አለቃ፥ ፊኖን አለቃ፥

verses.en: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.am: ቄኔዝ አለቃ፥ ቴማን አለቃ፥ ሚብሳር አለቃ፥

verses.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.am: መግዲኤል አለቃ፥ ዒራም አለቃ፤ እነዚህ የኤዶምያስ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
These are the sons of Yisra'el; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Yehudah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሮቤል፥ ስምዖን፥ ሌዊ፥ ይሁዳ፥ ይሳኮር፥ ዛብሎን፥

verses.en: Dan, Yoseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.am: ዳን፥ ዮሴፍ፥ ብንያም፥ ንፍታሌም፥ ጋድ፥ አሴር።

verses.en: The sons of Yehudah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Yehudah, was evil in the sight of YAHUAH; and he slew him.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆች፤ ዔር፥ አውናን፥ ሴሎም፤ እነዚህ ሦስቱ ከከነዓናዊቱ ከሴዋ ልጅ ተወለዱለት። የይሁዳም የበኵር ልጅ ዔር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነበረ፤ ገደለውም።

verses.en: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Yehudah were five.
verses.am: ምራቱም ትዕማር ፋሬስንና ዛራን ወለደችለት፤ የይሁዳም ልጆች ሁሉ አምስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.am: የፋሬስ ልጆች፤ ኤስሮም፥ ሐሙል።

verses.en: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.am: የዛራም ልጆች፤ ዘምሪ፥ ኤታን፥ ሄማን፥

verses.en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Yisra'el, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.am: ከልኮል፥ ዳራ፤ ሁሉም አምስት ነበሩ። የከርሚም ልጅ እስራኤልን ያስጨነቀ፥ እርሙንም ሰርቆ የበደለ አካን ነበረ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.am: የኤታንም ልጅ አዛርያ ነበረ።

verses.en: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.am: ለኤስሮም የተወለዱለት ልጆች፤ ይረሕምኤል፥ አራም፥ ካልብ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Yehudah;
verses.am: አራምም አሚናዳብን ወለደ፤ አሚናዳብም የይሁዳን ልጆች አለቃ ነአሶንን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.am: ነአሶንም ሰልሞንን ወለደ፤ ሰልሞንም ቦዔዝን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.am: ቦዔዝም ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቤድም እሴይን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.am: እሴይም የበኵር ልጁን ኤልያብን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አሚናዳብን፥ ሦስተኛውንም ሣማን፥

verses.en: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.am: አራተኛውንም ናትናኤልን፥

verses.en: Ozem the sixth, Dawid the seventh:
verses.am: አምስተኛውንም ራዳይን፥ ስድስተኛውንም አሳምን፥ ሰባተኛውንም ዳዊትን ወለደ፤

verses.en: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.am: እኅቶቻቸውም ጽሩያና አቢግያ ነበሩ። የጽሩያም ልጆች አቢሳ፥ ኢዮአብ፥ አሣሄል ሦስቱ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.am: አቢግያም አሜሳይን ወለደች፤ የአሜሳይም አባት እስማኤላዊው ዬቴር ነበረ።

verses.en: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.am: የኤስሮምም ልጅ ካሌብ ከሚስቱ ከዓዙባ ከይሪዖትም ልጆች ወለደ፤ ልጆቹዋም ያሳር፥ ሶባብ፥ አርዶን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.am: ዓዙባም ሞተች፥ ካሌብም ኤፍራታን አገባ፤ እርስዋም ሆርን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.am: ሆርም ኡሪን ወለደ፥ ኡሪም ባስልኤልን ወለደ።

verses.en: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ኤስሮም ስድሳ ዓመት በሆነው ጊዜ ወዳገባት ወደ ገለዓድ አባት ወደ ማኪር ልጅ ገባ፤ ሠጉብንም ወለደችለት። ሠጉብም ኢያዕርን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.am: ለእርሱም በገለዓድ ምድር ሀያ ሦስት ከተሞች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.am: ጌሹርና አራምም የኢያዕርን ከተሞች ከቄናትና ከመንደሮችዋ ጋር ስድሳውን ከተሞች ወሰዱባቸው። እነዚህ ሁሉ የገለዓድ አባት የማኪር ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.am: ኤስሮምም በካሌብ ኤፍራታ ከሞተ በኋላ የኤስሮም ሚስት አቢያ የቴቁሔን አባት አሽሑርን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.am: የኤስሮምም የበኵር ልጁ የይረሕምኤል ልጆች በኵሩ ራም፥ ቡናህ፥ ኦሬን፥ ኦጼም፥ አኪያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.am: ለይረሕምኤልም ዓጣራ የተባለች ሌላ ሚስት ነበረችው፤ እርስዋም የኦናም እናት ነበረች።

verses.en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.am: የይረሕምኤል የበኵሩ የራም ልጆች መዓስ፥ ያሚን፥ ዔቄር ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.am: የኦናምም ልጆች ሸማይና ያዳ ነበሩ። የሸማይ ልጆች ናዳብና አቢሱር ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.am: የአቢሱርም ሚስት አቢካኢል ነበረች፤ አሕባንንና ሞሊድን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.am: የናዳብም ልጆች ሴሊድና አፋይም ነበሩ፤ ሴሌድም ያለ ልጆች ሞተ።

verses.en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.am: የአፋይምም ልጅ ይሽዒ፥ የይሽዒም ልጅ ሶሳን፥ የሶሳንም ልጅ አሕላይ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.am: የሸማይም ወንድም የያዳ ልጆች ዬቴርና ዮናታን ነበሩ፤ ዬቴርም ያለ ልጆች ሞተ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.am: የዮናታንም ልጆች ፌሌትና ዛዛ ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ የይረሕምኤል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Mitsri, whose name was Jarha.
verses.am: ለሶሳንም ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ ለሶሳንም ኢዮሄል የተባለ ግብጻዊ አገልጋይ ነበረው።

verses.en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.am: ሶሳንም ለአገልጋዩ ለኢዮሄል ልጁን አጋባት፥ እርስዋም ዓታይን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.am: ዓታይም ናታንን ወለደ፤ ናታንም ዛባድን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.am: ዛባድም ኤፍላልን ወለደ፤ ኤፍላልም ዖቤድን ወለደ፤ ዖቤድም ኢዩን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.am: ኢዩም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.am: ዓዛርያስም ኬሌስን ወለደ፤ ኬሌስም ኤልዓሣን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.am: ኤልዓሣም ሲስማይን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.am: ሲስማይም ሰሎምን ወለደ፤ ሰሎምም የቃምያን ወለደ፤ የቃምያም ኤሊሳማን ወለደ።

verses.en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.am: የይረሕምኤልም ወንድም የካሌብ ልጆች በኵሩ የዚፍ አባት ሞሳ፥ የኬብሮንም አባት የመሪሳ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.am: የኬብሮንም ልጆች ቆሬ፥ ተፉዋ፥ ሬቄም፥ ሽማዕ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.am: ሽማዕም የዮርቅዓምን አባት ረሐምን ወለደ፤ ሬቄምም ሸማይን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
verses.am: የሸማይም ልጅ ማዖን ነበረ፤ ማዖንም የቤት ጹር አባት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.am: የካሌብም ቁባት ዔፋ ሐራንን፥ ሞዳን፥ ጋዜዝን ወለደች።

verses.en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.am: ሐራንም ጋዜዝን ወለደ። የያህዳይም ልጆች ሬጌም፥ ኢዮታም፥ ጌሻን፥ ፋሌጥ፥ ሔፋ፥ ሸዓፍ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.am: የካሌብም ቁባት ማዕካ ሸቤርንና ቲርሐናን ወለደች።

verses.en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.am: ደግሞም የመድማናን አባት ሸዓፍንና የመክቢናንና የጊብዓን አባት ሱሳን ወለደች፤ የካሌብም ሴት ልጅ ዓክሳ ነበረች።

verses.en: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
verses.am: የካሌብ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የኤፍራታ የበኵሩ የሆር ልጅ የቂርያትይዓሪም አባት ሦባል፥

verses.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
verses.am: የቤተ ልሔም አባት ሰልሞን፥ የቤት ጋዴር አባት ሐሬፍ።

verses.en: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
verses.am: ለቂርያትይዓሪምም አባት ለሦባል ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ሀሮኤ የመናሕታውያን እኵሌታ።

verses.en: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.am: የቂርያትይዓሪምም ወገኖች፤ ይትራውያን፥ ፉታውያን፥ ሹማታውያን፥ ሚሽራውያን፤ ከእነዚህም ጾርዓውያንና ኤሽታኦላውያን ወጡ።

verses.en: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.am: የሰልሞንም ልጆች ቤተ ልሔም፥ ነጦፋውያን፥ ዓጣሮትቤትዮአብ፥ የመናሕታውያን እኵሌታ፥ ጾርዓውያን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.am: በያቤጽም የተቀመጡ የጸሐፊዎች ወገኖች፤ ቲርዓውያን፥ ሺምዓታውያን፥ ሡካታውያን ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ ከሬካብ ቤት አባት ከሐማት የወጡ ቄናውያን ናቸው።

verses.en: Now these were the sons of Dawid, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Dani'el, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.am: በኬብሮንም ለዳዊት የተወለዱለት ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው። በኵሩ አምኖን ከኢይዝራኤላዊቱ ከአኪናሆም፥ ሁለተኛውም ዳንኤል ከቀርሜሎሳዊቱ ከአቢግያ፥

verses.en: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.am: ሦስተኛው አቤሴሎም ከጌሹር ንጉሥ ከተልማይ ልጅ ከመዓካ፥ አራተኛው አዶንያስ ከአጊት፥

verses.en: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.am: አምስተኛው ሰፋጥያስ ከአቢጣል፥ ስድስተኛው ይትረኃም ከሚስቱ ከዔግላ።

verses.en: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Yerushalayim he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.am: ስድስቱ በኬብሮን ተወለዱለት፤ በዚያም ሰባት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር ነገሠ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ ሦስት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And these were born unto him in Yerushalayim; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Shelomoh, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.am: እነዚህ ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም ተወለዱለት፤ ከዓሚኤል ልጅ ከቤርሳቤህ፥ ሳሙስ፥ ሶባብ፥ ናታን፥

verses.en: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.am: ሰሎሞን፥ አራት፤ ኢያቤሐር፥ ኤሊሱዔ፥

verses.en: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.am: ኤሊፋላት፥ ኖጋ፥ ናፌቅ፥ ያፍያ፥

verses.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.am: ኤሊሳማ፥ ኤሊዳሄ፥ ኤሊፋላት፥ ዘጠኝ።

verses.en: These were all the sons of Dawid, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ ከቁባቶች ልጆች በቀር የዳዊት ልጆች ነበሩ፤ ትዕማርም እኅታቸው ነበረች።

verses.en: And Shelomoh's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.am: የሰሎሞንም ልጅ ሮብዓም ነበረ፤ ልጁ አቢያ፥

verses.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.am: ልጁ አሳ፥ ልጁ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ ልጁ ኢዮራም፥ ልጁ አካዝያስ፥ ልጁ ኢዮአስ፥

verses.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.am: ልጁ አሜስያስ፥ ልጁ ዓዛርያስ፥ ልጁ ኢዮአታም፥

verses.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.am: ልጁ አካዝ፥ ልጁ ሕዝቅያስ፥ ልጁ ምናሴ፥

verses.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.am: ልጁ አሞጽ፥ ልጁ ኢዮስያስ።

verses.en: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.am: የኢዮስያስም ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ዮሐናን፥ ሁለተኛውም ኢዮአቄም፥ ሦስተኛውም ሴዴቅያስ፥ አራተኛውም ሰሎም።

verses.en: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.am: የኢዮአቄምም ልጆች፤ ልጁ ኢኮንያን፥ ልጁ ሴዴቅያስ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.am: የምርኮኛውም የኢኮንያን ልጆች ሰላትያል፥ መልኪራም፥

verses.en: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.am: ፈዳያ፥ ሼናጻር፥ ይቃምያ፥ ሆሻማ፥ ነዳብያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.am: የፈዳያ ልጆች ዘሩባቤልና ሰሜኢ ነበሩ፤ የዘሩባቤልም ልጆች፤ ሜሱላም፥ ሐናንያ፥ እኅታቸውም ሰሎሚት።

verses.en: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
verses.am: ሐሹባ፥ ኦሄል፥ በራክያ፥ ሐሳድያ፥ ዮሻብሒሴድ አምስት ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadyah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.am: የሐናንያም ልጆች ፈላጥያና የሻያ ነበሩ። የረፋያ ልጆች፥ የአርናን ልጆች፥ የአብድዩ ልጆች፥ የሴኬንያ ልጆች።

verses.en: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.am: የሴኬንያም ልጅ ሸማያ ነበረ። የሸማያም ልጆች ሐጡስ፥ ይግኣል፥ ባርያሕ፥ ነዓርያ፥ ሻፋጥ ስድስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.am: የነዓርያም ልጆች ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ሕዝቅያስ፥ ዓዝሪቃም ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.am: የኤልዮዔናይም ልጆች ሆዳይዋ፥ ኤልያሴብ፥ ፌልያ፥ ዓቁብ፥ ዮሐናን፥ ደላያ፥ ዓናኒ ሰባት ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Yehudah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆች ፋሬስ፥ ኤስሮም፥ ከርሚ፥ ሆር፥ ሦባል ናቸው።

verses.en: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.am: የሦባልም ልጅ ራያ ኢኤትን ወለደ፤ ኢኤትም አሑማይንና ላሃድን ወለደ። እነዚህ የጾርዓውያን ወገኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
verses.am: እነዚህም የኤጣም አባት ልጆች ናቸው፤ ኢይዝራኤል፥ ይሽማ፥ ይድባሽ፥ እኅታቸውም ሃጽሌልፎኒ።

verses.en: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.am: የጌዶርም አባት ፋኑኤል፥ የሑሻም አባት ኤጽር፤ እነዚህ የቤተ ልሔም አባት የኤፍራታ የበኵሩ የሆር ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.am: ለቴቁሔም አባት ለአሽሑር ሔላና ነዕራ የተባሉ ሁለት ሚስቶች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.am: ነዕራም አሑዛምን፥ ኦፌርን፥ ቴምኒን፥ አሐሽታሪን ወለደችለት። እነዚህ የነዕራ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.am: የሔላም ልጆች ዴሬት፥ ይጽሐር፥ ኤትናን ናቸው።

verses.en: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.am: ቆጽ ዓኑብን፥ ጾቤባን፥ የሃሩምንም ልጅ የአሐርሔልን ወገኖች ወለደ።

verses.en: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.am: ያቤጽም ከወንድሞቹ ይልቅ የተከበረ ነበረ፤ እናቱም። በጣር ወልጄዋለሁና ብላ ስሙን። ያቤጽ ብላ ጠራችው።

verses.en: And Jabez called on YAHUAH of Yisra'el, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And YAHUAH granted him that which he requested.
verses.am: ያቤጽም። እባክህ፥ መባረክን ባርከኝ፥ አገሬንም አስፋው፤ እጅህም ከእኔ ጋር ትሁን፤ እንዳያሳዝነኝም ከክፋት ጠብቀኝ ብሎ የእስራኤልን አምላክ ጠራ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የለመነውን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
verses.am: የሹሐም ወንድም ክሉብ የኤሽቶንን አባት ምሒርን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.am: ኤሽቶንም ቤትራ ፋንና ፋሴሐን የዒርናሐሽንም አባት ተሒናን ወለደ፤ እነዚህ የሬካ ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.am: የቄኔዝም ልጆች ጎቶንያልና ሠራያ ነበሩ። የጎቶንያልም ልጅ ሐታት ነበረ።

verses.en: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.am: መዖኖታይ ዖፍራን ወለደ። ሠራያም የጌሃራሽምን አባት ኢዮአብን ወለደ፤ እነርሱም ጠራቢዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.am: የዮፎኒም ልጅ የካሌብ ልጆች ዒሩ፥ ኤላ፥ ነዓም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.am: የኤላም ልጅ ቄኔዝ ነበረ። የይሃሌልኤል ልጆች ዚፍ፥ ዚፋ፥ ቲርያ፥ አሣርኤል ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.am: የዕዝራም ልጆች ዬቴር፥ ሜሬድ፥ ዔፌር፥ ያሎን ነበሩ፤ ዬቴርም ማርያምን፥ ሸማይን፥ የኤሽትምዓን አባት ይሽባን ወለደ።

verses.en: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.am: አይሁዳዊቱም ሚስቱ የጌዶርን አባት ዬሬድን፥ የሦኮንም አባት ሔቤርን፥ የዛኖዋንም አባት ይቁቲኤልን ወለደች። እነዚህም ሜሬድ ያገባት የፈርዖን ልጅ የቢትያ ልጆች ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.am: የሆዲያ ሚስት የነሐም እኅት ልጆች የገርሚው የቅዒላ አባትና ማዕካታዊው ኤሽትሞዓ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
verses.am: የሺሞንም ልጆች አምኖን፥ ሪና፥ ቤንሐናን፥ ቲሎን ነበሩ። የይሽዒም ልጆች ዞሔትና ቢንዞሔት ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Shelah the son of Yehudah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጅ የሴሎም ልጆች የሌካ አባት ዔር፥ የመሪሳ አባት ለዓዳ፥ ከአሽቤዓ ቤት የሚሆኑ ጥሩ በፍታ የሚሠሩ ወገኖች፥

verses.en: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
verses.am: ዮቂም፥ የኮዜባ ሰዎች፥ ኢዮአስ፥ ሞዓብን የገዛ ሣራፍ፥ ያሹቢሌሔም ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.am: ይህ ዝና ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ ነበረ። እነዚህ በነጣዒምና በጋዴራ የሚቀመጡ ሸክላ ሠራተኞች ነበሩ። በዚያ በንጉሡ ዘንድ ስለ ሥራው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
verses.am: የስምዖንም ልጆች፤ ነሙኤል፥ ያሚን፥ ያሪን፥ ዛራ፥ ሳኡል፤

verses.en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.am: ልጁ ሰሎም፥ ልጁ መብሳም፥ ልጁ ማስማዕ።

verses.en: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.am: የማስማዕም ልጆች፤ ልጁ ሃሙኤል፥ ልጁ ዘኩር፥ ልጁ ሰሜኢ።

verses.en: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Yehudah.
verses.am: ለሰሜኢም አሥራ ስድስት ወንዶችና ስድስት ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ለወንድሞቹ ግን ብዙ ልጆች አልነበሩአቸውም፥ ወገናቸውም ሁሉ እንደ ይሁዳ ልጆች አልተባዙም።

verses.en: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
verses.am: በቤርሳቤህም፥ በሞላዳ፥

verses.en: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.am: በሐጸርሹዓል፥ በቢልሃ፥ በዔጼም፥

verses.en: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.am: በቶላድ፥ በቤቱኤል፥ በሔርማ፥ በጺቅላግ፥

verses.en: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of Dawid.
verses.am: በቤትማርካቦት፥ በሐጸርሱሲም፥ በቤትቢሪ፥ በሸዓራይም ይቀመጡ ነበር። እስከ ዳዊትም መንግሥት ድረስ ከተሞቻቸው እነዚህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.am: መንደሮቻቸውም ኤጣም፥ ዓይን፥ ሬሞን፥ ቶኬን፥ ዓሻን፥ አምስቱ ከተሞች፤

verses.en: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.am: እስከ በኣልም ድረስ በእነዚህ ከተሞች ዙሪያ የነበሩ መንደሮቻቸው ሁሉ ነበሩ። መቀመጫቸውና የትውልዳቸው መዝገቦች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.am: ምሾባብ፥ የምሌክ፥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ ኢዮስያ፥

verses.en: And Yo'el, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.am: ኢዮኤል፥ የዮሺብያ ልጅ፥ የሠራያ ልጅ የዓሢኤል ልጅ ኢዩ፥

verses.en: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.am: ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ያዕቆባ፥ የሾሐያ፥ ዓሣያ፥ ዓዲዔል፥ ዩሲምኤል፥ በናያስ፥

verses.en: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.am: የሺፊ ልጅ ዚዛ፥ የአሎን ልጅ የይዳያ ልጅ የሺምሪ ልጅ የሸማያ ልጅ፤

verses.en: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.am: እነዚህ በስማቸው የተጠሩ በወገኖቻቸው ላይ አለቆች ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች በዝተው ነበር።

verses.en: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.am: ለመንጎቻቸው መሰምርያ ይሹ ዘንድ ወደ ጌዶር መግቢያ እስከ ሸለቆው ምሥራቅ ድረስ ሄዱ።

verses.en: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.am: የለመለመችም እጅግም ያማረች መሰምርያ አገኙ፤ ምድሪቱም ሰፊና ጸጥተኛ ሰላም ያላትም ነበረች፤ በቀድሞም ጊዜ በዚያ ተቀምጠው የነበሩ ከካም ወገን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Yehudah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.am: እነዚህም በስማቸው የተጻፉ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን መጥተው ድንኳኖቻቸውንና በዚያ የተገኙትን ምዑናውያንን መቱ፥ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ፈጽመው አጠፉአቸው፤ በዚያም ለመንጎቻቸው መሰምርያ ነበረና በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.am: የስምዖንም ልጆች አምስት መቶ ሰዎች ወደ ሴይር ተራራ ሄዱ፤ አለቆቻቸውም የይሽዒ ልጆች፥ ፈላጥያ፥ ነዓርያ፥ ረፋያ፥ ዑዝኤል ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.am: ያመለጡትንም የአማሌቃውያንን ቅሬታ መቱ፥ በዚያም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Yisra'el, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Yoseph the son of Yisra'el: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም በኵር የሮቤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው። እርሱ የበኵር ልጅ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን የአባቱን ምንጣፍ ስላረከሰ ብኵርናው ለእስራኤል ልጅ ለዮሴፍ ልጆች ተሰጠ፤ ትውልዱ ግን ከብኵርና ጋር አልተቈጠረም።

verses.en: For Yehudah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Yoseph's:)
verses.am: ይሁዳም በወንድሞቹ መካከል በረታ፥ አለቃም ከእርሱ ሆነ፤ ብኵርናው ግን ለዮሴፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Yisra'el were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.am: የእስራኤል በኵር የሮቤል ልጆች፤ ሄኖኅ፥ ፈሉሶ፥ አስሮን፥ ከርሚ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Yo'el; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.am: የኢዮኤል ልጆች፤ ልጁ ሸማያ፥

verses.en: Mikah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.am: ልጁ ጎግ፥ ልጁ ሰሜኢ፥ ልጁ ሚካ፥

verses.en: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.am: ልጁ ራያ፥ ልጁ ቢኤል፥ የአሦር ንጉሥ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር የማረከው ልጁ ብኤራ፤ እርሱ የሮቤል ነገድ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zekaryah,
verses.am: ወንድሞቹ በየወገናቸው የትውልዶቻቸው መዝገብ በተቈጠረ ጊዜ፤ አንደኛው ኢዮኤል፥

verses.en: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Yo'el, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
verses.am: ዘካርያስ፥ እስከ ናባውና እስከ በኣልሜዎን ድረስ በአሮዔር የተቀመጠው የኢዮኤል ልጅ የሽማዕ ልጅ የዖዛዝ ልጅ ቤላ፤

verses.en: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.am: በገለዓድ ምድር እንስሶቻቸው በዝተው ነበርና በምሥራቅ በኩል ከኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ምድረ በዳው መግቢያ ድረስ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And in the days of Sha'ul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
verses.am: በሳኦልም ዘመን ከአጋራውያን ጋር ተዋጉ፥ እነርሱም በእጃቸው ተመትተው ወደቁ፤ በገለዓድ ምሥራቅ በኩል ባለው አገር ሁሉ በድንኳኖቻቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
verses.am: የጋድም ልጆች በባሳን ምድር እስከ ሰልካ ድረስ በአፋዛዣቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Yo'el the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.am: አንደኛው ኢዮኤል፥ ሁለተኛው ሳፋም፥ ያናይ፥ ሳፋጥ በበሳን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ወንድሞች ሚካኤል፥ ሜሱላም፥ ሳባ፥ ዮራይ፥ ያካን፥ ዙኤ፥ ኦቤድ ሰባት ነበሩ።

verses.en: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.am: እነዚህም የቡዝ ልጅ የዬዳይ ልጅ የኢዬሳይ ልጅ የሚካኤል ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጅ የኢዳይ ልጅ የዑሪ ልጅ የአቢካኢል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቃ የጉኒ ልጅ የአብዲኤል ልጅ ወንድም ነበረ።

verses.en: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
verses.am: በገለዓድም ምድር በባሳን በመንደሮቹም በሳሮንም መሰምርያዎች ሁሉ እስከ ዳርቻቸው ድረስ ተቀምጠው ነበር።

verses.en: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Yehudah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ በትውልዶቻቸው በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮአታም ዘመንና በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
verses.am: የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆች የምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ፥ ጽኑዓን፥ ጋሻና ሰይፍ የሚይዙ፥ ቀስተኞችም፥ ሰልፍ የሚያውቁ ሰልፈኞችም፥ አርባ አራት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.am: ከአጋራውያንና ከኢጡር ከናፌስና ከናዳብ ጋር ተዋጉ።

verses.en: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to YAHUAH in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.am: በሚዋጉበትም ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸዋልና፥ በእርሱም ታምነዋልና ተለመናቸው፤ በላያቸውም ረዳት ሆናቸው፥ አጋራውያንና ከእነርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም ሁሉ በእጃቸው ተሰጡ።

verses.en: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
verses.am: ከከብቶቻቸውም አምሳ ሺህ ግመሎች፥ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሺህም በጎች፥ ሁለት ሺህም አህዮች፥ ከሰዎችም መቶ ሺህ ማረኩ።

verses.en: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of YAHUAH. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.am: ሰልፉ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረና ብዙ ሰዎች ተገድለው ወደቁ፤ እስከ ምርኮም ዘመን ድረስ በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.am: የምናሴ የነገድ እኵሌታ ልጆች በምድሪቱ ተቀመጡ። ከባሳንም ጀምሮ እስከ በኣልአርሞንዔምና እስከ ሳኔር እስከ አርሞንዔም ተራራ ድረስ በዙ።

verses.en: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Yirmeyahu, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ዔፌር፥ ይሽዒ፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ዓዝርኤል፥ ኤርምያ፥ ሆዳይዋ፥ ኢየድኤል፤ እነርሱ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን የታወቁ ሰዎች የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they transgressed against YAHUAH of their fathers, and went a whoring after the elohim of the people of the land, whom YAHUAH destroyed before them.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ በደሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው ባጠፋቸው በምድሩ አሕዛብ አማልክት አመነዘሩ።

verses.en: And YAHUAH of Yisra'el stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም አምላክ የአሦርን ንጉሥ የፎሐን መንፈስ፥ የአሦርንም ንጉሥ የቴልጌልቴልፌልሶርን መንፈስ አስነሣ፤ የሮቤልንና የጋድን ልጆች የምናሴንም ነገድ እኵሌታ አፈለሰ፥ እስከ ዛሬም ወዳሉበት ወደ አላሔና ወደ ኦቦር፥ ወደ ሃራና ወደ ጎዛን ወንዝ አመጣቸው።

verses.en: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.am: የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.am: የቀዓትም ልጆች፤ እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል።

verses.en: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Mosheh, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.am: የእንበረምም ልጆች፤ አሮን፥ ሙሴ፥ ማርያም። የአሮን ልጆች፤ ናዳብ፥ አብዮድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር።

verses.en: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.am: አልዓዛር ፊንሐስን ወለደ፤ ፊንሐስ አቢሱን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.am: አቢሱም ቡቂን ወለደ፤ ቡቂም ኦዚን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.am: ኦዚም ዘራእያን ወለደ፤ ዘራእያም መራዮትን ወለደ፤

verses.en: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.am: መራዮት አማርያን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.am: አማርያም አኪጦብን ወለደ፤ አኪጦብም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም አኪማአስን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.am: አኪማአስም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Shelomoh built in Yerushalayim:)
verses.am: ዓዛርያስም ዮሐናንን ወለደ፤ ዮሐናንም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤ እርሱም ሰሎሞን በኢየሩሳሌም በሠራው ቤት ካህን ነበረ፤

verses.en: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.am: ዓዛርያስም አማርያን ወለደ፤ አማርያም አኪጦብን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.am: አኪጦብም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም ሰሎምን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.am: ሰሎምም ኬልቅያስን ወለደ፤ ኬልቅያስም ዓዛርያስን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.am: ዓዛርያስም ሠራያን ወለደ፤ ሠራያም ኢዮሴዴቅን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when YAHUAH carried away Yehudah and Yerushalayim by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን በናቡከደነፆር እጅ ባስማረከ ጊዜ ኢዮሴዴቅ ተማርኮ ሄደ።

verses.en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.am: የሌዊ ልጆች፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.am: የጌድሶንም ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፤ ሎቤኒ ሰሜኢ።

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.am: የቀዓትም ልጆች፤ እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.am: የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ሞሖሊም፥ ሙሲ። የሌዋውያን ወገኖች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.am: ከጌድሶን፤ ልጁ ሎቤኒ፥ ልጁ ኢኤት፥ ልጁ ዛማት፥

verses.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.am: ልጁ ዮአክ፥ ልጁ አዶ፥ ልጁ ዛራ፥ ልጁ ያትራይ።

verses.en: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.am: የቀዓት ልጆች፤ ልጁ አሚናዳብ፥

verses.en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.am: ልጁ ቆሬ፥ ልጁ አሴር፥ ልጁ ሕልቃና፥

verses.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.am: ልጁ አቢሳፍ፥ ልጁ አሴር፥ ልጁ ኢኢት፥ ልጁ ኡሩኤል፥ ልጁ ዖዝያ፥ ልጁ ሳውል።

verses.en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.am: የሕልቃናም ልጆች፤ አማሢ፥ አኪሞት።

verses.en: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.am: የሕልቃናም ልጆች፤ ልጁ ሱፊ፥

verses.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.am: ልጁ ናሐት፥ ልጁ ኤልያብ፥ ልጁ ይሮሐም፥ ልጁ ሕልቃና።

verses.en: And the sons of Shemu'el; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.am: የሳሙኤልም ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ኢዮኤል፥ ሁለተኛውም አብያ።

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.am: የሜራሪ ልጆች፤ ሞሖሊ፥ ልጁ ሎቤኒ፥ ልጁ ሰሜኢ፥

verses.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.am: ልጁ ዖዛ፥ ልጁ ሳምዓ፥ ልጁ ሐግያ፥ ልጁ ዓሣያ።

verses.en: And these are they whom Dawid set over the service of song in the house of YAHUAH, after that the ark had rest.
verses.am: ዳዊትም ታቦቱ ዐርፎ ከተቀመጠ በኋላ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ያቆማቸው የመዘምራን አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Shelomoh had built the house of YAHUAH in Yerushalayim: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት በኢየሩሳሌም እስኪሠራ ድረስ በመገናኛ ድንኳን ማደሪያ ፊት እያዜሙ ያገለግሉ ነበር፤ በየተራቸውም ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Yo'el, the son of Shemuel,
verses.am: አገልጋዮቹና ልጆቹ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከቀዓት ልጆች ዘማሪው ኤማን ነበረ፤ እርሱም የኢዮኤል ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.am: የሳሙኤል ልጅ፥ የሕልቃና ልጅ፥ የይሮሐም ልጅ፥ የኤሊኤል ልጅ፥ የቶዋ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.am: የሱፍ ልጅ፥ የሕልቃና ልጅ፥ የመሐት ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Yo'el, the son of Azariah, the son of Tsephanyah,
verses.am: የአማሢ ልጅ፥ የሕልቃና ልጅ፥ የኢዮኤል ልጅ፥ የዓዛርያስ ልጅ፥ የሶፎንያስ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.am: የታሐት ልጅ፥ የአሴር ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Yisra'el.
verses.am: የአብያሳፍ ልጅ፥ የቆሬ ልጅ፥ የይስዓር ልጅ፥ የቀዓት ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ፥ የእስራኤል ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.am: በቀኙም የቆመ ወንድሙ አሳፍ ነበረ፤ አሳፍም የበራክያ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.am: የሳምዓ ልጅ፥ የሚካኤል ልጅ፥ የበዓሤያ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.am: የመልክያ ልጅ፥ የኤትኒ ልጅ፥ የዛራ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.am: የዓዳያ ልጅ፥ የኤታን ልጅ፥ የዛማት ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.am: የሰሜኢ ልጅ፥ የኢኤት ልጅ፥ የጌድሶን ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.am: በግራቸውም በኩል ወንድሞቻቸው የሜራሪ ልጆች ነበሩ፤ ኤታን የቂሳ ልጅ፥ የአብዲ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.am: የማሎክ ልጅ፥ የሐሸብያ ልጅ፥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.am: የኬልቅያስ ልጅ፥ የአማሲ ልጅ፥

verses.en: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.am: የባኒ ልጅ፥ የሴሜር ልጅ፥ የሞሖሊ ልጅ፥ የሙሲ ልጅ፥ የሜራሪ ልጅ፥ የሌዊ ልጅ።

verses.en: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም ሌዋውያን ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ሁሉ ተሰጡ።

verses.en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Yisra'el, according to all that Mosheh the servant of YAHUAH had commanded.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጆቹ ግን የእግዚአሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ሥራ ሁሉ ስለ እስራኤልም ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ ይሠዉ ነበር፥ በዕጣኑም መሠዊያ ላይ ያጥኑ ነበር።

verses.en: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ልጁ አልዓዛር፥

verses.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.am: ልጁ ፊንሐስ፥ ልጁ አቢሱ፥ ልጁ ቡቂ፥

verses.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.am: ልጁ ኦዚ፥ ልጁ ዘራእያ፥ ልጁ መራዮት፥

verses.en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.am: ልጁ አማርያ፥ ልጁ አኪጦብ፥ ልጁ ሳዶቅ፥ ልጁ አኪማአስ።

verses.en: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.am: ማደሪያዎቻቸውም በየሰፈራቸው በየዳርቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ለአሮን ልጆች ለቀዓት ወገኖች አንደኛው ዕጣ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Yehudah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.am: ለእነርሱ በይሁዳ አገር ያለችውን ኬብሮንን፥ በእርስዋም ዙሪያ የነበረውን መሰምርያ ሰጡ፤

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.am: የከተማይቱን እርሻ ግን መንደሮችዋንም ለዮፎኒ ልጅ ለካሌብ ሰጡ።

verses.en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Yehudah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.am: ለአሮንም ልጆች የመማፀኛውን ከተሞች፥ ኬብሮንን፥ ልብናንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ደግሞ የቲርን፥

verses.en: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.am: ኤሽትሞዓንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ሖሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዳቤርንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
verses.am: ዓሳንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቤትሳሚስንና መሰምርያዋን፤

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.am: ከብንያምም ነገድ ጌባንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጋሌማትንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዓናቶትንና መሰምርያዋን ሰጡ። ከተሞቻተው ሁሉ በየወገናቸው አሥራ ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.am: ለቀሩትም ለቀዓት ልጆች ከነገዱ ወገን ከምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ አሥር ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡ።

verses.en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.am: ለጌድሶንም ልጆች በየወገናቸው ከይሳኮር ነገድ፥ ከአሴርም ነገድ፥ ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ፥ በባሳንም ካለው ከምናሴ ነገድ፥ አሥራ ሦስት ከተሞች ተሰጡ።

verses.en: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.am: ለሜራሪ ልጆች በየወገናቸው ከሮቤል ነገድ፥ ከጋድም ነገድ፥ ከዛብሎንም ነገድ፥ አሥራ ሁለት ከተሞች በዕጣ ተሰጡ።

verses.en: And the children of Yisra'el gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለሌዋውያን ከተሞችን ከመሰምርያዎቻቸው ጋር ሰጡ።

verses.en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Yehudah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ልጆች ነገድ፥ ከስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ፥ ከብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ፥ እነዚህን በስማቸው የተጠሩትን ከተሞች በዕጣ ሰጡ።

verses.en: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.am: ከቀዓትም ልጆች ወገኖች ለአንዳንዶቹ ከኤፍሬም ነገድ ከተሞች ድርሻ ነበራቸው።

verses.en: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.am: በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ያሉትን የመማፀኛውን ከተሞች ሴኬምንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ደግሞም ጌዝርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ዮቅምዓምንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
verses.am: ቤትሖሮንንና መሰምርያዋን፥

verses.en: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
verses.am: ኤሎንንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ጋትሪሞንንና መሰምርያዋን ሰጡአቸው።

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.am: ከምናሴም ነገድ እኵሌታ ዓኔርንና መሰምርያዋን፥ ቢልዓምንና መሰምርያዋን ከቀዓት ልጆች ወገን ለቀሩት ሰጡ።

verses.en: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.am: ለጌድሶን ልጆች ከምናሴ ነገድ እኵሌታ ወገን በባሳን ያለችው ጎላንና መሰምርያዋ፥ አስታሮትና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከይሳኮርም ነገድ ቃዴስና መሰምርያዋ፥ ዳብራትና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.en: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.am: ራሞትና መሰምርያዋ፥ ዓኔምና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከአሴርም ነገድ መዓሳልና መሰምርያዋ፥ ዓብዶንና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.en: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.am: ሑቆቅና መሰምርያዋ፥ ረአብና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌምም ነገድ በገሊላ ያለችው ቃዴስና መሰምርያዋ፥ ሐሞንና መሰምርያዋ፥ ቂርያታይምና መሰምርያዋ ተሰጡ።

verses.en: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.am: ከሌዋውያን ለቀሩት ለሜራሪ ልጆች ከዛብሎን ነገድ ሬሞንና መሰምርያዋ፥ ታቦርና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከሮቤልም ነገድ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምሥራቅ በኩል በምድረ በዳ ያለችው ቦሶርና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.en: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.am: ያሳና መሰምርያዋ፥ ቅዴሞትና መሰምርያዋ፥ ሜፍዓትና መሰምርያዋ፤

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.am: ከጋድም ነገድ በገለዓድ ያለችው ሬማትና መሰምርያዋ፥ መሃናይምና መሰምርያዋ፥

verses.en: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.am: ሐሴቦንና መሰምርያዋ፥ ኢያዜርና መሰምርያዋ ተሰጡ።

verses.en: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.am: የይሳኮርም ልጆች፥ ቶላ፥ ፉዋ፥ ያሱብ ሺምሮን፥ አራት ናቸው።

verses.en: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of Dawid two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.am: የቶላም ልጆች፥ ኦዚ፥ ራፋያ፥ ይሪኤል፥ የሕማይ፥ ይብሣም፥ ሽሙኤል፥ የአባታቸው የቶላ ቤት አለቆች፥ በትውልዳቸው ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ በዳዊት ዘመን ቍጥራቸው ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadyah, and Yo'el, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.am: የኦዚም ልጆች ይዝረሕያ፤ የይዝረሕያም ልጆች ሚካኤል፥ አብድዩ፥ ኢዮኤል፥ ይሺያ አምስት ናቸው፤ ሁሉም አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር በየትውልዳቸው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ለሰልፍ የተዘጋጁ የሠራዊት ጭፍሮች ነበሩ፤ ብዙም ሴቶችና ልጆች ነበሩአቸውና ሠላሳ ስድስት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም በይሳኮር ወገኖች ሁሉ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች በትውልዳቸው ሁሉ የተቈጠሩ ሰማኒያ ሰባት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.am: የብንያም ልጆች ቤላ፥ ቤኬር፥ ይዲኤል ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.am: የቤላም ልጆች፥ ኤሴቦን፥ ኦዚ፥ ዑዝኤል፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ ዒሪ፥ አምስት ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ በትውልድ የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሠላሳ አራት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
verses.am: የቤኬርም ልጆች፤ ዝሚራ፥ ኢዮአስ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኤልዮዔናይ፥ ዖምሪ፥ ኢያሪሙት፥ አብያ፥ ዓናቶት፥ ዓሌሜት፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የቤኬር ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.am: በየትውልዳቸው መዝገብ የተቈጠሩ፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ሀያ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.am: የይዲኤልም ልጅ ቢልሐን ነበረ፤ የቢልሐንም ልጆች የዑስ፥ ብንያም፥ ኤሁድ፥ ክንዓና፥ ዜታን፥ ተርሴስ፥ አኪሳአር ነበሩ።

verses.en: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ የይዲኤል ልጆች ነበሩ፤ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ ጭፍራ እየሆኑ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች አሥራ ሰባት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.am: ደግሞም ሳፊን፥ ሑፊም የዒር ልጆች፥ ሑሺም የአሔር ልጆችም ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች፥ ያሕጽኤል፥ ጉኒ፥ ዬጽር፥ ሺሌም፥ የባላ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.am: የምናሴ ልጆች ሶርያይቱ ቁባቱ የወለደችለት እሥርኤልና የገለዓድ አባት ማኪር ናቸው።

verses.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.am: ማኪርም ከሑፊምና ከሳፊን ወገን ሚስት አገባ፤ የእኅትዋም ስም መዓካ ነበረ፤ የሁለተኛውም ስም ሰለጰአድ ነበረ፤ ለሰለጰዓድም ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.am: የማኪርም ሚስት መዓካ ልጅ ወለደች፥ ስሙንም ፋሬስ ብላ ጠራችው፤ የወንድሙም ስም ሱሮስ ነበረ፤ ልጆቹም ኡላም፥ ራቄም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.am: የኡላምም ልጅ ባዳን ነበረ፤ እነዚህ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.am: እኅቱ መለኬት ኢሱድን፥ አቢዔዝርን፥ መሕላን ወለደች።

verses.en: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.am: የሸሚዳም ልጆች አሒያን፥ ሴኬም፥ ሊቅሒ፥ አኒዓም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ልጆች፤ ሹቱላ፥ ልጁ ባሬድ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ኤልዓዳ፥ ልጁ ታሐት፥ ልጁ ዛባድ፥ ልጁ ሽቱላ፥

verses.en: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.am: የአገሩም ተወላጆች የጌት ሰዎች ከብቶቻቸውን ሊወስዱ ወርደው ነበርና የገደሉአቸው ልጆቹ ኤድርና ኤልዓድ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.am: አባታቸውም ኤፍሬም ብዙ ቀን አለቀሰ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሊያጽናኑት መጡ።

verses.en: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.am: ወደ ሚስቱም ገባ፥ አረገዘችም፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች፤ በቤቱም መከራ ሆኖአልና ስሙ በሪዓ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
verses.am: ሴት ልጁም ታችኛውንና ላይኛውን ቤትሖሮንንና ኡዜንሼራን የሠራች ሲአራ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቹም ፋፌ፥ ሬሴፍ፥ ልጁ ቴላ፥

verses.en: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.am: ልጁ ታሐን፥ ልጁ ለአዳን፥ ልጁ ዓሚሁድ፥ ልጁ ኤሊሳማ፥

verses.en: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.
verses.am: ልጁ ነዌ፥ ልጁ ኢያሱ።

verses.en: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
verses.am: ግዛታቸውና ማደሪያቸው ቤቴልና መንደሮችዋ፥ በምሥራቅም በኩል ነዓራን፥ በምዕራብም በኩል ጌዝርና መንደሮችዋ፥ ደግሞ ሴኬምና መንደሮችዋ እስከ ጋዛና እስከ መንደሮችዋ ድረስ፥

verses.en: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Yoseph the son of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በምናሴም ልጆች ዳርቻ ቤትሳንና መንደሮችዋ፥ ታዕናክና መንደሮችዋ፥ መጊዶና መንደሮችዋ፥ ዶርና መንደሮችዋ ነበሩ፤ በእነዚህ የእስራኤል ልጅ የዮሴፍ ልጆች ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.am: የአሴር ልጆች ዪምና፥ የሱዋ፥ የሱዊ፥ በሪዓ፥ እኅታቸውም ሤራሕ።

verses.en: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.am: የበሪዓም ልጆች፤ ሔቤር፥ የቢርዛዊት አባት የነበረው መልኪኤል።

verses.en: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.am: ሔቤርም ያፍሌጥን፥ ሳሜንር፥ ኮታምን፥ እኅታቸውንም ሶላን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.am: የያፍሌጥም ልጆች ፋሴክ፥ ቢምሃል፥ ዓሲት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ የያፍሌጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.am: የሳሜርም ልጆች አኪ፥ ሮኦጋ፥ ይሑባ፥ አራም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.am: የወንድሙም የኤላም ልጆች ጾፋ፥ ይምና፥ ሰሌስ፥ ዓማል ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.am: የጾፋም ልጆች ሱዋ፥ ሐርኔፍር፥

verses.en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.am: ሦጋል፥ ቤሪ፥ ይምራ፥ ቤጼር፥ ሆድ፥ ሳማ፥ ሰሊሳ፥ ይትራን፥ ብኤራ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.am: የዬቴር ልጆች ዮሮኒ፥ ፊስጳ፥ አራ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.am: የዑላ ልጆች ኤራ፥ ሐኒኤል፥ ሪጽያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ የአሴር ልጆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች፥ የተመረጡ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች፥ የመኳንንቱ አለቆች ነበሩ። በትውልዳቸውም በሰልፍ ለመዋጋት የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ስድስት ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.am: ብንያምም በኵሩን ቤላን፥ ሁለተኛውንም አስቤልን፥

verses.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.am: ሦስተኛውንም አሐራን፥ አራተኛውንም ኖሐን፥ አምስተኛውንም ራፋን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.am: ለቤላም ልጆች ነበሩት፤ አዳር፥

verses.en: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.am: ጌራ፥ አቢሁድ፥ አቢሱ፥ ናዕማን፥ አሖዋ፥ ጌራ፥ ሰፉፋም፥ ሑራም።

verses.en: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.am: እነዚህም የኤሁድ ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ በጌባ የሚቀመጡ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ናቸው፤

verses.en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.am: እነዚህም የኤሁድ ልጆች ናቸው፤ እነዚህ በጌባ የሚቀመጡ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ናቸው፤

verses.en: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.am: ወደ መናሐትም ተማረኩ፤ ናዕማን፥ አኪያ፥ ጌራ፥ እነርሱም ተማረኩ። ዖዛንና አሒሑድን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.am: ሸሐራይምም ሚስቶቹን ሑሺምንና በዕራን ከሰደደ በኋላ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.am: ከሚስቱ ከሖዴሽ ዮባብን፥

verses.en: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.am: ዲብያን፥ ማሴን፥ ማልካምን፥ ይዑጽን፥ ሻክያን፥ ሚርማን ወለደ። እነዚህም ልጆች የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.am: ከሑሺምም አቢጡብንና ኤልፍዓልን ወለደ።

verses.en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.am: የኤልፍዓልም ልጆች፤ ዔቤር፥ ሚሻም፥ ኦኖንና ሎድን መንደሮቻቸውንም የሠራ ሻሚድ፤

verses.en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.am: በሪዓ፥ ሽማዕ የጌትን ሰዎች ያሳደዱ የኤሎን ሰዎች የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.am: አሒዮ፥ ሻሻቅ፥ ይሬምት፥

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.am: ዝባድያ፥ ሜሱላም፥

verses.en: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.am: ዝባድያ፥ ሜሱላም፥

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.am: ሕዝቂ፥ ሔቤር፥ ይሽምራይ፥ ይዝሊያ፥ ዮባብ፥ የኤልፍዓል ልጆች፤

verses.en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.am: ያቂም፥ ዝክሪ፥ ዘብዲ፥

verses.en: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.am: ይሽጳን፥

verses.en: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.am: ይሽጳን፥

verses.en: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.am: ዔቤር፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ዓብዶን፥ ዝክሪ፥

verses.en: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.am: ሸምሽራይ፥

verses.en: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.am: ሸምሽራይ፥

verses.en: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.am: ሸሃሪያ፥ ጎቶልያ፥ ያሬሽያ፥ ኤልያስ፥ ዝክሪ፥ የይሮሐም ልጆች።

verses.en: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.am: እነዚህ በትውልዶቻቸው አለቆች ነበሩ፤ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.am: የሚስቱ ስም መዓካ የነበረው የገባዖን አባት ይዒኤል፥

verses.en: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.am: የበኵር ልጁ ዓብዶን፥

verses.en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ዱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ናዳብ፥ ጌዶር፥ አሒዮ፥ ዛኩር በገባዖን ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.am: ሚቅሎት ሳምአን ወለደ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.am: ኔር ቂስን ወለደ፤ ቂስም ሳኦልን ወለደ፤ ሳኦልም ዮናታንን፥ ሚልኪሳን፥ አሚናዳብን፥ አስባኣልን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.am: የዮናታንም ልጅ መሪበኣል ነበረ፤ መሪበኣልም ሚካን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Yerushalayim, over against them.
verses.am: የሚካም ልጆች ፒቶን፥ ሜሌክ፥ ታሬዓ፥ አካዝ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Sha'ul, and Sha'ul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.am: አካዝም ይሆዓዳን ወለደ፤ ይሆዓዳም ዓሌሜትን፥ ዓዝሞትን፥ ዘምሪን ወለደ፤ ዘምሪም ሞጻን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Mikah.
verses.am: ሞጻም ቢንዓን ወለደ፤ ልጁም ረፋያ ነበረ፥ ልጁ ኤልዓሣ፥ ልጁ ኤሴል፤

verses.en: And the sons of Mikah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.am: ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሽዓርያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.am: የወንድሙም የአሴል ልጆች፤ በኵሩ ኡላም፥ ሁለተኛውም ኢያስ፥ ሦስተኛውም ኤሊፋላት።

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.am: የኡላም ልጆች ጽኑዓን ኃያላንና ቀስተኞች ነበሩ፤ ለእነርሱም መቶ አምሳ የሚያህሉ ብዙ ልጆችና የልጅ ልጆች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የብንያም ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadyah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
So all Yisra'el were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Yisra'el and Yehudah, who were carried away to Babel for their transgression.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በየትውልዳቸው ተቈጠሩ፤ እነሆም፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል። ይሁዳም ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ወደ ባቢሎን ተማረኩ።

verses.en: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Yisra'elites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.am: በአውራጃዎቻቸውና በከተሞቻቸው መጀመሪያ የተቀመጡ እስራኤልና ካህናት ሌዋውያንም ናታኒምም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And in Yerushalayim dwelt of the children of Yehudah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ልጆችና ከብንያም ልጆች ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴ ልጆች በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Yehudah.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ልጅ ከፋሬስ ልጆች የባኒ ልጅ የአምሪ ልጅ የፆምሪ ልጅ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ዑታይ ደግሞ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.am: ከሴሎናዊያንም በኵሩ ዓሣያና ልጆቹ።

verses.en: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.am: ከዛራም ልጆች ይዑኤልና ወንድሞቻቸው፥ ስድስት መቶ ዘጠና።

verses.en: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.am: ከብንያምም ልጆች የሐስኑአ ልጅ የሆዳይዋ ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ ሰሉ፤

verses.en: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.am: የይሮሐም ልጅ ብኔያ፤ የሚክሪ ልጅ የኦዚ ልጅ ኤላ፤ የዪብኒያ ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጅ የሰፋጥያስ ልጅ ሜሱላም፤

verses.en: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.am: በየትውልዳቸውም ወንድሞቻቸው ዘጠኝ መቶ ሃምሳ ስድስት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.am: ከካህናቱም ዮዳሄ፥ ዮአሪብ፥ ያኪን፤

verses.en: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of YAHUAH;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አለቃ የአኪጦብ ልጅ የመራዮት ልጅ የሳዶቅ ልጅ ሜሱላም ልጅ የኬልቂያስ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ፤

verses.en: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.am: የመልኪያ ልጅ የጳስኮር ልጅ የይሮሐም ልጅ ዓዳያ፤ የኢሜር ልጅ የምሺላሚት ልጅ የሜሱላም ልጅ የየሕዜራ ልጅ የዓዲኤል ልጅ መዕሣይ፤

verses.en: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች ወንድሞቻቸው ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ማገልገል ሥራ እጅግ ብልሃተኞች ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም የሜራሪ ልጆች የአሳብያ ልጅ የዓዝሪቃም ልጅ የአሱብ ልጅ ሸማያ፤

verses.en: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mikah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.am: በቅበቃር፥ ኤሬስ፥ ጋላል፥ የኣሳፍ ልጅ የዝክሪ ልጅ የሚካ ልጅ መታንያ፤

verses.en: And Obadyah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.am: የኤዶታም ልጅ የጋላል ልጅ የሰሙስ ልጅ አብድያ፤ በነጦፋውያንም መንደሮች የተቀመጠው የሕልቃና ልጅ የአሳ ልጅ በራክያ።

verses.en: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
verses.am: በረኞችም ሰሎም፥ ዓቁብ፥ ጤልሞን፥ አሒማን፥ ወንድሞቻቸውም ነበሩ፤ ሰሎምም አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.am: እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ በንጉሥ በር በምሥራቅ በኩል ነበሩ፤ ለሌዊ ልጆች ሰፈር በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of YAHUAH, were keepers of the entry.
verses.am: የቆሬም ልጅ የአብያሳፍ ልጅ የቆሬ ልጅ ሰሎም ከአባቱም ቤት የነበሩ ወንድሞቹ ቆሬያውያን በማገልገል ሥራ ላይ ነበሩ፥ የድንኳኑንም መድረክ ይጠብቁ ነበር። አባቶቻቸውም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰፈር መግቢያ ጠብቀው ነበር።

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and YAHUAH was with him.
verses.am: አስቀድሞም የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ አለቃቸው ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ።

verses.en: And Zekaryah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.am: የሜሱላም ልጅ ዘካርያስ የመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ በረኛ ነበረ።

verses.en: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom Dawid and Shemu'el the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.am: የመድረኩ በረኞች ይሆኑ ዘንድ የተመረጡ እነዚህ ሁሉ ሁለት መቶ አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ። ዳዊትና ነቢዩ ሳሙኤል በሥራቸው ያቆሙአቸው እነዚህ በመንደሮቻቸው በየትውልዳቸው ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of YAHUAH, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.am: እነርሱና ልጆቻቸውም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በድንኳኑ ደጆች ላይ ዘበኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.am: በአራቱ ማዕዘኖች፥ በምሥራቅ፥ በምዕራብ፥ በሰሜን፥ በደቡብ፥ በረኞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻቸውም በመንደሮቻቸው ሆነው፥ በየሰባትም ቀን ከእነርሱ ጋር ሊሆኑ ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ይገቡ ነበር።

verses.en: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም የነበሩ አራቱ የበረኞች አለቆች ዘወትር በሥራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ባሉ ጓዳዎችና ቤተ መዛግብት ላይ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they lodged round about the house of YAHUAH, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት የሚጠብቁ፥ ጥዋት ጥዋትም ደጆቹን የሚከፍቱ እነርሱ ነበሩና በዚያ ያድሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.am: ዕቃውም በቍጥር ይገባና ይወጣ ነበርና ከእነዚህ አንዳንዱ በማገልገያው ዕቃ ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ በመቅደሱ ዕቃ ሁሉ በመልካሙም ዱቄት፥ በወይን ጠጁ፥ በዘይቱም፥ በዕጣኑም፥ በሽቱውም ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.am: ከካህናቱም ልጆች አንዳንዶቹ የሽቱውን ቅባት ያጣፍጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.am: የቆሬያዊውም የሰሎም በኵር ሌዋዊው ማቲትያ በምጣድ በሚጋገረው ነገር ላይ ሹም ነበረ።

verses.en: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.am: በየሰንበቱም ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ ከወንድሞቻቸው ከቀዓታውያን አንዳንዱ በገጹ ኅብስት ላይ ሹሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያኑም ወገን የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች የነበሩ መዘምራን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሥራቸውም ሌሊትና ቀን ነበረና ያለሌላ ሥራ በየጓዳቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Yerushalayim.
verses.am: እነዚህ ከሌዋውያን የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች በየትውልዳቸው አለቆች ነበሩ። እነዚህም በኢየሩሳሌም ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.am: የሚስቱ ስም መዓካ የነበረው የገባዖን አባት ይዒኤል፥

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.am: የበኵር ልጁም ዓብዶን፥

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zekaryah, and Mikloth.
verses.am: ዱር፥ ቂስ፥ በኣል፥ ኔር፥ ናዳብ፥ ጌዶር፥ አሒዮ፥ ዛኩር፥ ሚቅሎት፥ በገባኦን ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Yerushalayim, over against their brethren.
verses.am: ሚቅሎትም ሳምአን ወለደ፤ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም በወንድሞቻቸው ፊት ለፊት ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Sha'ul; and Sha'ul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.am: ኔርም ቂስን ወለደ፤ ቂስም ሳኦልን ወለደ፤ ሳኦልም ዮናታንን፥ ሚልኪሳን፥ አሚናዳብን፥ አስበኣልን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Mikah.
verses.am: የዮናታንም ልጅ መሪበኣል ነበረ፤ መሪበኣልም ሚካን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Mikah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.am: የሚካም ልጆች ፒቶን፥ ሜሌክ፥ ታሬዓ፥ አካዝ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.am: አካዝም የዕራን ወለደ፤ የዕራም ዓሌሜትን፥ ዓዝሞትን፥ ዘምሪን ወለደ፤ ዘምሪም ሞጻን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.am: ሞጻም ቢንዓን ወለደ፥ ልጁም ረፋያ ነበረ፥ ልጁ ኤልዓሣ፥ ልጁ ኤሴል፤

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadyah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.am: ለኤሴልም ስድስት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ዓዝሪቃም፥ ቦክሩ፥ እስማኤል፥ ሸዓሪያ፥ አብድዩ፥ ሐናን፤ እነዚህ የኤሴል ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now the Philistines fought against Yisra'el; and the men of Yisra'el fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋጉ፤ የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ፥ ተወግተውም በጊልቦአ ተራራ ላይ ወደቁ።

verses.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Sha'ul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Sha'ul.
verses.am: ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በእግር በእግራቸው ተከትለው አባረሩአቸው፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም የሳኦልን ልጆች ዮናታንንና አሚናዳብን ሜልኪሳንም ገደሉ።

verses.en: And the battle went sore against Sha'ul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.am: ሰልፍም በሳኦል ላይ ጠነከረ፥ ቀስተኞችም አገኙት፤ ከቀስተኞችም የተነሣ ተጨነቀ።

verses.en: Then said Sha'ul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Sha'ul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.am: ሳኦልም ጋሻ ጃግሬውን። እነዚህ ቈላፋን መጥተው እንዳይዘብቱብኝ ሰይፍህን መዝዘህ ውጋኝ አለው። ጋሻ ጃግሬው ግን እጅግ ፈርቶ ነበርና እንቢ አለ። ሳኦልም ሰይፉን ወስዶ በላዩ ወደቀ።

verses.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Sha'ul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.am: ጋሻ ጃግሬውም ሳኦል እንደ ሞተ ባየ ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በሰይፉ ላይ ወድቆ ሞተ።

verses.en: So Sha'ul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.am: ሳኦልና ሦስቱ ልጆቹ የቤቱም ሰዎች ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ሞቱ።

verses.en: And when all the men of Yisra'el that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Sha'ul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.am: በሸለቆውም የነበሩት የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ እንደ ሸሹ፥ ሳኦልና ልጆቹም እንደ ሞቱ ባዩ ጊዜ ከተሞቻቸውን ለቅቀው ሸሹ፤ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም መጥተው ተቀመጡባቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Sha'ul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.am: በነጋውም ፍልስጥኤማውያን የሞቱትን ለመግፈፍ በመጡ ጊዜ ሳኦልንና ልጆቹን በጊልቦአ ተራራ ላይ ወድቀው አገኙአቸው።

verses.en: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.am: ገፈፉትም፥ ራሱንና መሣሪያውንም አንሥተው ለጣኦቶቻቸውና ለሕዝቡ የምሥራች ይወስዱ ዘንድ ወደ ፍልስጥኤማውያን አገር ዙሪያ ሰደዱ።

verses.en: And they put his armour in the house of their elohim, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.am: መሣሪያውንም በአምላኮቻቸው ቤት ውስጥ አኖሩ፤ ራሱንም በዳጎን ቤት ውስጥ ቸነከሩት።

verses.en: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Sha'ul,
verses.am: የኢያቢስ ገለዓድም ሰዎች ሁሉ ፍልስጥኤማውያን በሳኦል ላይ ያደረጉትን ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Sha'ul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.am: ጽኑአን ሰዎች ሁሉ ተነሥተው የሳኦልን ሬሳ የልጆቹንም ሬሳ ወሰዱ፥ ወደ ኢያቢስም አመጡአቸው፤ በኢያቢስም ካለው ከትልቁ ዛፍ በታች አጥንቶቻቸውን ቀበሩ፥ ሰባት ቀንም ጾሙ።

verses.en: So Sha'ul died for his transgression which he committed against YAHUAH, even against the word of YAHUAH, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
verses.am: እንዲሁ ሳኦል በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ስላደረገው ኃጢአት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ስላልጠበቀ ሞተ። ደግሞም መናፍስት ጠሪ

verses.en: And enquired not of YAHUAH: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto Dawid the son of Jesse.
verses.am: ስለ ጠየቀ እግዚአብሔርንም ስላልጠየቀ፥ ስለዚህ ገደለው፥ መንግሥቱንም ወደ እሴይ ልጅ ወደ ዳዊት አሳለፈው።

verses.en: Then all Yisra'el gathered themselves to Dawid unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ በኬብሮን ወደ ዳዊት ተሰብስበው። እነሆ፥ እኛ የአጥንትህ ፍላጭ የሥጋህ ቍራጭ ነን፤

verses.en: And moreover in time past, even when Sha'ul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Yisra'el: and YAHUAH thy YAHUAH said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Yisra'el, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Yisra'el.
verses.am: አስቀድሞ ሳኦል ንጉሥ ሆኖ ሳለ እስራኤልን የምታወጣና የምታገባ አንተ ነበርህ፤ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም። ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን አንተ ትጠብቃለህ፤ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ትሆናለህ 5ብሎህ ነበር አሉት።

verses.en: Therefore came all the elders of Yisra'el to the king to Hebron; and Dawid made a covenant with them in Hebron before YAHUAH; and they anointed Dawid king over Yisra'el, according to the word of YAHUAH by Shemu'el.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ኬብሮን መጡ፤ ዳዊትም በኬብሮን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን ከእነርሱ ጋር አደረገ፤ በሳሙኤልም እጅ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል በእስራኤል ላይ ንጉሥ ይሆን ዘንድ ዳዊትን ቀቡት።

verses.en: And Dawid and all Yisra'el went to Yerushalayim, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.am: ዳዊትም እስራኤልም ሁሉ ኢያቡስ ወደምትባል ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዱ፤ በአገሩም የተቀመጡ ኢያቡሳውያን በዚያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to Dawid, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless Dawid took the castle of Zion, which is the city of Dawid.
verses.am: በኢያቡስም የተቀመጡ ዳዊትን። ወደዚህ አትገባም አሉት፤ ዳዊት ግን አምባይቱን ጽዮንን ያዘ፤ እርሷም የዳዊት ከተማ ናት።

verses.en: And Dawid said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.am: ዳዊትም። ኢያቡሳውያንን አስቀድሞ የሚመታ ሰው አለቃና መኰንን ይሆናል አለ። የጽሩያም ልጅ ኢዮአብ አስቀድሞ ወጣ፥ አለቃም ሆነ።

verses.en: And Dawid dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of Dawid.
verses.am: ዳዊትም በአምባይቱ ውስጥ ተቀመጠ፤ ስለዚህም የዳዊት ከተማ ብለው ጠሩአት።

verses.en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.am: ከሚሎም ጀምሮ በዙሪያው ከተማ ሠራ፤ ኢዮአብም የቀረውን ከተማ አበጀ።

verses.en: So Dawid waxed greater and greater: for YAHUAH of hosts was with him.
verses.am: ዳዊትም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበርና እየበረታ ሄደ።

verses.en: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom Dawid had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Yisra'el, to make him king, according to the word of YAHUAH concerning Yisra'el.
verses.am: ለዳዊትም የነበሩት የኃያላን አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ስለ እስራኤል እንደ ተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ያነግሡት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ጋር በመንግሥቱ ላይ አጸኑት።

verses.en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom Dawid had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.am: የዳዊትም ኃያላን ቍጥር ይህ ነበረ፤ የሠላሳው አለቃ የአክሞናዊው ልጅ ያሾብአም ነበረ፤ እርሱ ጦሩን አንሥቶ ሦስት መቶ ሰው በአንድ ጊዜ ገደለ።

verses.en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ በሦስቱ ኃያላን መካከል የነበረ የአሆሃሂው የዱዲ ልጅ አልዓዛር ነበር።

verses.en: He was with Dawid at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.am: እርሱ ከዳዊት ጋር በፈስደሚም ነበረ፥ በዚያም ገብስ በሞላበት እርሻ ውስጥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ለሰልፍ ተሰብስበው ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ፊት ሸሹ።

verses.en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and YAHUAH saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.am: በእርሻውም መካከል ቆመው ጠበቁት፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ገደሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ማዳን አዳናቸው።

verses.en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to Dawid, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.am: ከሠላሳውም አለቆች ሦስቱ ወርደው ዳዊት ወዳለበት ወደ ዓለቱ ወደ ዓዶላም ዋሻ መጡ፤ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በራፋይም ሸለቆ ሰፍሮ ነበር።

verses.en: And Dawid was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ዳዊት በምሽጉ ውስጥ ነበረ፥ የፍልስጥኤማውያንም ጭፍራ በቤተ ልሔም ነበረ።

verses.en: And Dawid longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
verses.am: ዳዊትም። በበሩ አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውሃ ማን ይሰጠኛል? ብሎ ተመኘ።

verses.en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to Dawid: but Dawid would not drink of it, but poured it out to YAHUAH,
verses.am: እነዚህም ሦስቱ የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ሠራዊት ቀድደው ሄዱ፥ በበሩም አጠገብ ካለችው ከቤተ ልሔም ምንጭ ውሃ ቀዱ፤ ይዘውም ለዳዊት አመጡለት። እርሱ ግን ሊጠጣ አልወደደም፥ ነገር ግን ለእግዚአብሔር አፍስሶ።

verses.en: And said, My YAHUAH forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.am: ይህን አደርግ ዘንድ አምላኬ ይከልክለኝ፤ በነፍሳቸው የደፈሩትም እነዚህ ሰዎች ደም እጠጣለሁን? በነፍሳቸው አምጥተውታል አለ። ስለዚህም ይጠጣ ዘንድ አልወደደም። ሦስቱም ኃያላን ያደረጉት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.am: የኢዮአብም ወንድም አቢሳ የሦስቱ አለቃ ነበረ፤ ጦሩንም በሦስት መቶ ላይ አንሥቶ ገደላቸው፥ በሦስቱም መካከል ስሙ የተጠራ ነበረ።

verses.en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ተራ በሆኑት በሦስቱ መካከል የከበረ ነበረ፥ አለቃቸውም ሆነ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ፊተኞቹ ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም።

verses.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.am: በቀብስኤልም የነበረው፥ ታላቅ ሥራ ያደረገው የጽኑዕ ሰው የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ የሞዓባዊን የአሪኤል ሁለቱን ልጆች ገደለ፤ በአመዳይም ወራት ወርዶ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ አንበሳ ገደለ።

verses.en: And he slew an Mitsri, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Mitsri's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Mitsri's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.am: ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ የነበረውን ረጅሙን ግብጻዊውን ሰው ገደለ፤ በግብጻዊውም እጅ የሸማኔ መጠቅለያ የመሰለ ጦር ነበረ፤ እርሱ ግን በትር ይዞ ወደ እርሱ ወረደ፥ ከግብጻዊውም እጅ ጦሩን ነቅሎ በገዛ ጦሩ ገደለው።

verses.en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.am: የዮዳሄ ልጅ በናያስ ያደረገው ይህ ነው፤ ስሙም በሦስቱ ኃያላን መካከል የተጠራ ነበር።

verses.en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and Dawid set him over his guard.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከሠላሳው ይልቅ የከበረ ነበረ፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ፊተኞቹ ወደ ሦስቱ አልደረሰም። ዳዊትም በዘበኞቹ ላይ ሾመው።

verses.en: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.am: ደግሞም በጭፍሮች ዘንድ የነበሩት ኃያላን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ የኢዮአብ ወንድም አሣሄል፥ የቤተ ልሔሙ ሰው የዱዲ ልጅ ኤልያናን፥

verses.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.am: ሃሮራዊው ሳሞት፥ ፈሎናዊው ሴሌስ፥

verses.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
verses.am: የቴቁሔ ሰው የዒስካ ልጅ ዒራስ፥

verses.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.am: ዓናቶታዊው አቢዔዜር፥ ኩሳታዊው ሴቤካይ፥

verses.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.am: አሆሃዊው ዔላይ፥ ነጦፋዊው ኖኤሬ፥ የነጦፋዊው የበዓና ልጅ ሔሌድ፥

verses.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.am: ከብንያም ወገን ከግብዓ የሪባይ ልጅ ኤታይ፥

verses.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.am: ጲርዓቶናዊው በናያስ፥ የገዓስ ወንዝ ሰው ኡሪ፥

verses.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.am: ዓረባዊው አቢኤል፥ ባሕሩማዊው ዓዝሞት፥

verses.en: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.am: ሰዓልቦናዊው ኤሊያሕባ፥ የጊዞናዊው የአሳን ልጆች፥ የሃራራዊው የሻጌ ልጅ ዮናታን፥

verses.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.am: የአሮዳዊው የአራር ልጅ አምናን፥

verses.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.am: የኡር ልጅ ኤሊፋል፥ ሚኬራታዊው ኦፌር፥

verses.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.am: ፍሎናዊው አኪያ፥ ቀርሜሎሳዊው ሐጽሮ፥ የኤዝባይ ልጅ ነዕራይ፥
